title: Two Sum
statement: Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `target`, return the indices of the two numbers that add up to `target`. Exactly one answer exists and an element may not be used twice. Return the indices in any order.
interviewerNotes: Brute force is O(n^2). Expected: one pass with a hash map from value to index, O(n) time and space. Hints: (1) what do you need to know about earlier elements? (2) can a lookup structure answer that in O(1)? Follow-ups: sorted input (two pointers), duplicates, no solution.
